prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a sideswipe while changing lanes. The patient had 38 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1293; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment kept growing well beyond what this injury usually needs, with more visits and new services added month after month.
- Objective tests go against the complaints: imaging is normal and the patient moved freely when observed outside the exam room.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presents following a sideswipe collision during a lane change, with complaints of cervical and lumbar strain. The mechanism and force of the reported impact are consistent with the soft-tissue injury described, and no prior injury to the neck or low back is known to this provider. Care was delivered over 38 visits, with additional services layered in over successive months, a pattern of expansion that exceeds what is typically expected for uncomplicated strain of this type. Cervical and lumbar imaging was unremarkable, and on several occasions the patient was observed moving with full range of motion outside the examination room, which does not align with the restriction reported during formal testing. Two similar charges dated the same day are currently under review by billing for accuracy. Ongoing monitoring and a functional reassessment are recommended before any further treatment is authorized.
